what: A cumbia generator in the Monterrey Colombian tradition: roll the die for a new song with accordion, bass, guacharaca and congas, throw in sonidero shouts with echo, and slow it all down like a cumbia rebajada. Tribute to Celso Piña and Sonido Dueñez.
author: Alan Daf
sounds: licensed: free sample banks for the percussion and accordion, royalty-free; the shouts are the author's own recordings; piano, flute and sax CC0 (VSCO-2-CE, VCSL, from Felucca)
